project_name: Marvel Electronics and Home Entertainment E-Store
initial_requirements: Marvel Electronics and Home Entertainment needs an online store to support the sale, distribution, and marketing of electronic products. Customers should be able to browse categorized product information, search the catalogue, and configure products from available components before ordering. The business also needs a way to present detailed product information and manage the customer-facing sales experience through the store.

turns.interviewer_utterance: What are the primary business outcomes Marvel Electronics and Home Entertainment wants this online store to achieve—for example, increased sales, improved product discovery, self-service ordering, or better customer engagement?
turns.interviewee_utterance: The main goal is definitely to increase sales by making it easier for customers to find products and place orders online. We also want better product discovery through browsing and search, and we want customers to be able to configure and order products themselves without needing a lot of manual support. A secondary outcome is to present our products more professionally so the store helps with marketing and customer engagement as well.

turns.interviewer_utterance: Who are the key stakeholders and user groups involved in this online store—such as customers, sales staff, product managers, marketing team members, or administrators—and what responsibilities or needs does each group have?
turns.interviewee_utterance: The main user group is customers, who need to browse, search, compare, configure, and order products easily. Sales staff will likely need access to customer and order information so they can help with inquiries and follow up on sales. Product and marketing teams need to manage product information, promotions, and how products are presented, while administrators would handle overall store setup, access, and day-to-day maintenance.

slots.name: project_goals
slots.value: Increase sales by making it easier for customers to find products and place orders online; improve product discovery through browsing and search; enable self-service product configuration and ordering with minimal manual support; present products more professionally to support marketing and customer engagement.

slots.name: stakeholder_roles
slots.value: Customers browse, search, compare, configure, and order products; sales staff access customer and order information to support inquiries and follow up on sales; product and marketing teams manage product information, promotions, and product presentation; administrators handle store setup, access, and day-to-day maintenance.

slots.name: functional_needs
slots.value: Support browsing and searching products, comparing products, configuring products from available components, placing orders online, viewing detailed product information, managing product information and promotions, and maintaining the customer-facing store experience.

slots.name: data_entities
slots.value: Products, product components, product categories, customer records, orders, promotions, and product information/content.

slots.name: constraints
slots.value: The store must support the customer-facing sales experience and provide tools for managing product information and promotions; product configuration is limited to available components.

slots.name: quality_concerns
slots.value: Usability for easy browsing, searching, configuring, and ordering; professional presentation for marketing and customer engagement; maintainability for day-to-day store and content management.

slots.name: product_catalog_navigation
slots.value: Customers can browse categorized product information and navigate the product catalogue to find products easily.

slots.name: search_capabilities
slots.value: Customers can search the product catalogue to locate products and improve product discovery.

slots.name: product_configuration_flow
slots.value: Customers can configure products from available components before ordering, with self-service configuration and minimal manual support.

slots.name: marketing_content_management
slots.value: Product and marketing teams can manage product information, promotions, and how products are presented to customers.

slots.name: order_placement_process
slots.value: Customers can place orders online after browsing, searching, and configuring products.
